OPTIONAL / ESTIMATE BEFORE YOU BUY

Critical power planner

Enter measured daily energy for the devices you need. A small battery can support lights and phones; heating and cooling can require much more.

No recharge assumed. This does not check output watts, surge, connectors or medical compatibility. 80% is an illustrative efficiency assumption; test actual runtime.

Generator safety essentials

Fuel-burning generators belong outdoors, at least 20 feet from doors, windows and vents, exhaust directed away. Never run one in a garage or carport. Never backfeed a wall outlet; house connections require qualified installation. Use working CO alarms, proper cords and safe fuel storage. CDC guidance ↗
